department: Department of Mechanical and Process Engineering (D-MAVT)

deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission needs the approval of a D-MAVT professor who will supervise you; the Doctoral Committee then decides after consulting the supervisor.
supervisor.quote: requires a Master's degree in engineering or natural sciences and the approval of a professor who will act as the supervisor

funding.value: Apart from a few exceptions, ETH doctoral students are employed (salaried) as scientific assistants.
funding.quote: Apart from a few exceptional cases, all doctoral students at ETH Zurich are employed as scientific assistants.

entry_route.value: A Master's in engineering or natural sciences is required; D-MAVT aims for the top 10% of their Bachelor's/Master's programmes.
entry_route.quote: requires a Master's degree in engineering or natural sciences | D-MAVT aims to admit excellent students (in the top 10% of their Bachelor's/Master's programmes) from recognised institutions.

notes: The Doctoral Committee may admit you to the extended doctoral programme (12 extra credits of graded exams). D-MAVT also covers process engineering.
